sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Generative Artificial Intelligence and LLM Inference APIs

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with selected common-law influences in corporate and maritime law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-Spain Agreement on Reciprocal Protection of Investments (1996)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (Ley de Prevención de Blanqueo de Capitales y Financiamiento del Terrorismo), as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019; Decreto Ejecutivo No. 52 de 2016 (beneficial ownership reporting); Acuerdo No. 3 de 2018 de la Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); and Ley No. 32 de 1927 (sociedades anónimas).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each shareholder and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Civil Registry / Notary Public in home country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for the Panamanian registered agent
Certificate of incorporation of parent entity, if corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for each UBO (standard under AML enhanced due diligence, alternative to formal credit report)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners must be screened against OFAC-SDN, UN Consolidated, EU Consolidated, and Panama UAF/CLD sanctions lists, and must be nationality/risk flagged. PEPs must be identified through a risk-based questionnaire and are subject to enhanced due diligence, including senior management approval. Automated screening using commercial databases must be completed before client acceptance; continuous transaction monitoring applies post-onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – En Línea (Panama Public Registry Online)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin characters; Spanish and any adequately transliterated foreign words are accepted. The name must include 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'. The Registry will reject names that are phonetically or graphically identical, or misleadingly similar, to existing registered names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five (5) business days of rejection, file a written 'Recurso de Apelación' with the Director General of the Registro Público, attaching the prior name-search certificate and grounds for distinctiveness. Alternatively, file a corrected name application on-line. No statutory extension applies beyond the 30-day reservation window; a new reservation request must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for registration/licensing purposes; a registered agent must maintain a physical address in Panama. A virtual office may satisfy the registered-office address requirement, but any operational substance (bank account, invoicing, contracts) should include a practical business address. For an AI-LLM API platform with no physical presence, the registered agent's address is sufficient, subject to substance-notification requirements for tax residence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% annual probability) for a non-licensed, low-risk online service provider; inspections may increase if there are tax or AML triggers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Registry en línea)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for online name search (Resolución No. 082-2020)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation filing with Registro Público (Sociedad Anónima, standard authorized capital US$10,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of Articles of Incorporation and internal corporate records
Registered agent fees – first year (includes registered office address)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered Agent (law firm or qualified service provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry filing and identification package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá via Registered Agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for beneficial ownership reporting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille of incorporation certificate (one certified copy)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama (Vice Ministry of Multilateral Relations)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Articles of Incorporation (for banking and customer due diligence)
Compliance/UBO identification package preparation for AML risk assessment

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (General Corporation Law) – Law No. 32 of 1927, as amended; Articles 1 (incorporation), 4 (lawful purpose), 24 (registered agent), 33 (capital stock), 35-42 (directors), and related provisions of the Panamanian Commercial Code and Public Registry regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Mercantile Section / Legal Persons Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos / Certificado de Incorporación (Articles of Incorporation and Certificate of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory paid-up capital requirement; authorized capital may be fixed at a nominal amount (commonly USD 10,000) with shares issued as fully or partly paid. No escrow deposit or proof of capital contribution is required at incorporation under Law 32 of 1927.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the share subscriptions set forth in its Articles of Incorporation, and the initial stated capital is declared to be fully represented by issued shares, with the corresponding certificates to be delivered to the subscribers. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office address stated in the Articles of Incorporation is adopted as the Corporation's statutory registered office and resident agent address, and the registered agent is confirmed. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the initial officers are elected as President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each with authority to act jointly in the name of the Corporation. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the President and Secretary are authorized to execute documents for registration, municipal licensing, banking, and tax compliance. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Legal Persons Registration Section (online portal: www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Public Registry's name pre-validation platform, request an availability check for the proposed Sociedad Anónima name, and file a formal name reservation through the registered user account. Attach a scanned copy of the subscriber's identification and a corporate purpose description. The name is reserved for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Name pre-validation and reservation form
Copy of valid passport or Panamanian cédula of each subscriber
Statement of corporate purpose and desired authorized capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected as confusingly similar or contrary to public order, submit a revised name list and request administrative reconsideration within 10 business days; alternatively file a new reservation with approved distinctive elements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary of the Circuit of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: A licensed Panamanian attorney drafts the Pacto Social y Estatutos containing the corporate name, lawful purpose, authorized capital, resident agent, director and shareholder provisions, and duration. The subscribers appear before the notary with valid identification, sign the instrument, and the notary issues the authenticated notarial copy.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation and bylaws
Name reservation confirmation
Valid passport or cédula of each founding shareholder and director
Certified Spanish translation of any non-Spanish corporate documents, if applicable
Registered agent appointment and consent letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects inconsistencies or incomplete identification, execute a corrective addendum before the same notary and re-notarize the first filing; no cost consequence beyond statutory notary fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Corporation with the Public Registry and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section / Legal Persons Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized articles through the registry's authorized filings office or online submission system. Pay the stamp tax and registry fees at the designated collection counters or online gateway. After ministerial review, the registry inscribes the corporation and issues the Certificado de Incorporación, which makes the legal entity effective.
required_dossiers: Notarized articles of incorporation
Certificate of name reservation
Payment receipt for official registry and stamp fees
Registered agent appointment consent
Identification copies of directors and corporate officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry files an observation (razón de defecto), the registered agent has 10 working days to respond through the arreglo procedure; provide additional certifications or clarify inconsistencies. If time expires, re-file with a new covering letter and pay a reintegration fee if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificado de Incorporación and registered office information to DGI either online through the Sede Electrónica or at an attention window. Complete the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) application, obtain the corporate NIT, and secure the digital signature certificate for electronic filing.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Incorporación issued by the Public Registry
Notarized corporate authorization of the legal representative
Passport or cédula of the legal officer
Proof of registered office address (lease or title)
Corporate due diligence documentation as requested by DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI requires additional due diligence, submit the responding declaration and supporting notarial affidavit; any rejection of tax status can be cured by filing an administrative appeal with the DGI Legal Department and re-submitting the RUC form within 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of the District of the Registered Office – Tesorería Municipal / Municipal Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the standardized Aviso de Operación application with the municipality of the company's registered office, identifying the generative AI/API commercial category and confirming no physical manufacturing. Pay the municipal operating fee at the local treasury window or online municipal portal. Obtain the stamped municipal license and, if required, the certificate of inspection.
required_dossiers: RUC/NIT registration certificate
Certificado de Incorporación
Copy of lease agreement or title of registered address
Identification documents of the legal representative
Municipal application form signed by the resident agent or director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality raises zoning or activity-classification questions, present a letter explaining the wholly digital and intangible nature of the API service and request classification under 'Servicios en Línea'; municipal practice permits remote-business licensing without specific land-use permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security and Occupational Risk Employer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) – Department of National and Employers Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If any employees will be engaged, register the S.A. as an employer with CSS and obtain the employer account number. Concurrently register the employer with the occupational risk insurance (Riesgos Profesionales) and the Ministry of Labor and Labor Development (MITRADEL) for the workforce plan. If the company has no staff at formation, file a declaration of inactive employer status.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Incorporación and RUC/NIT
Officer appointment minutes and power of attorney
Identification documents of directors
CSS employer registration form
Payroll plan (nominal plan of first employees), if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should CSS reject registration due to outstanding liabilities of predecessor entities, clear the debts and present the release certificate; the employer can then be registered with retroactive effect from the first payroll date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for non-industrial generative AI/LLM API services. General oversight: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) and municipal licensing authority at the local level.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (municipal commercial license) plus RUC/NIT registration; no sectoral manufacturing or technology-specific operating permit is required for AI API publishing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – pure digital service with no physical manufacturing, wastewater discharge, or point-source emissions; no mandatory EIA report is required. A voluntary Carta de Compromiso Ambiental may be requested only if the company operates a large physical office or data center.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC point-source emissions are generated for an AI API platform. If a colocation data center is used, the data center operator must comply with national electrical and cooling isolation standards and applicable MiAMBIENTE noise/waste handling regulations; the API company itself has no direct environmental discharge permit obligations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and inspection from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá is required before occupying any physical office. For server rooms or cooling equipment, submit an electrical-load and structural-load statement by a licensed engineer. Register the workplace with the Occupational Health and Safety Directorate of CSS/MITRADEL before commencing staff presence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Directorate of Revenue (Dirección General de Ingresos, DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama; official web portal: https://www.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) must obtain its RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) before engaging in taxable operations. The registration procedure includes: (1) filing the RUC application with DGI through the web portal or authorized service window; (2) presenting certified articles of incorporation, the notarized public deed, registered agent (agente residente) confirmation, municipal business license or aviso de operación, and identification documents for the officers; (3) receiving the RUC certificate, which also registers the company for the transfer tax on goods and services (ITBMS) where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a check-the-box or comparable pass-through election. A Panamanian S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer taxed only on Panama-source income. No domestic hybrid mismatch election is available. A qualifying small taxpayer may elect the simplified small-taxpayer regime for income tax purposes within statutory turnover limits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Panama VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover-based ITBMS registration threshold; registration is compulsory for any person habitually selling taxable goods or services in Panama. An optional simplified small-taxpayer regime is available only for taxpayers with annual gross turnover below B/.36,000 (PAB 36,000, equal to USD 36,000).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing through the DGI Facturación Electrónica system. E-invoices must be transmitted to DGI or through an authorized service provider for validation, must include a DGI-authorized fiscal authorization code and QR stamp, and must be digitally signed with the taxpayer's electronic trust certificate. Certified billing software must integrate with DGI web services/APIs for issuance, cancellation, authorization, and real-time clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Panama qualify for the 0% ITBMS rate when the goods physically leave customs territory under a customs export declaration. Services supplied to non-residents and effectively consumed or exploited abroad qualify for 0%, as do services directly related to exported goods. The taxpayer must be ITBMS-registered, issue an export invoice at 0%, and retain documentary evidence of the export transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) with customs exit validation
Bill of Lading or air waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed Panama banking institution
Electronic export invoice with DGI fiscal authorization code/QR
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audits export zero-rating by cross-matching electronic invoices, customs DUA records, transport documents, and inward remittance certificates. Failure to substantiate the export or repatriation of payment within the required deadline results in reversal of the 0% rate, assessment of 7% ITBMS plus monthly interest, penalties generally from 50% to 100% of the omitted tax, and criminal liability where fraudulent zero-rating is established. Limitation periods are extended in cases of fraud, and retrospective clawbacks can cover at least six fiscal years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá — National Banking Superintendency; Banco Nacional de Panamá operates as fiscal agent of the Republic of Panama. No central bank exists in Panama and no national currency is issued; the U.S. Dollar is legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized economy with absolute currency convertibility and no exchange-control restrictions. Current-account and capital-account transactions are freely permitted, including profit repatriation, dividend distributions, loan servicing, and capital redemption. There is no prior central-bank authorization for transfers of any amount, and no withholding or transfer tax on outward remittances is imposed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no mandatory surrender, no minimum conversion ratio, and no statutory timeline for export receipts. Exporters may retain proceeds indefinitely in U.S. Dollar accounts or in foreign currency accounts, and may freely use such funds for domestic or cross-border obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC Credomatic / BAC International Bank, Inc. (Panama Branch)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium for unlicensed offshore digital Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs). Panama's Banking Law (Cabinet Decree 23 of 1970) prohibits deposit-taking without an SBP banking license, and there is no distinct EMI license. Offshore EMIs may operate only through a carefully structured correspondent or sponsorship arrangement with an SBP-licensed bank. The Innovation Hub/Sandbox supervised by SBP provides a legal path for fintech payment services, but high-risk crypto-linked EMIs face additional AML/CFT scrutiny. A Panama S.A. should prefer a local banking relationship rather than an unlicensed offshore EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally possible for low-risk corporate clients with a strong documentary dossier; physical appearance of directors is not statutorily mandatory. Banks typically accept Apostilled power of attorney, certified corporate documents, UBO register, and biometric video interviews. However, a physical presence requirement is often imposed for at least one beneficial owner or senior officer during initial account activation, especially for cross-border digital-business clients. The compliance officer may require an in-person meeting to satisfy conclusive KYC for any medium-risk classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership, historical bearer-share structure, or nominee director usage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the current shareholder registry; complete Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (final beneficial owner register) under Law 23 of 2015; resignation/revocation of nominee directors; audited financial statements; sworn statement of source of wealth and funds; apostilled corporate public deed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: AI API / software-as-a-service activity deemed high-risk cross-border IT or telecommunications business by compliance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan and service description; ISIC 6201 certification; executed customer contracts and invoices; website and public platform evidence; telemetry or usage log; regulatory license determination showing no financial license requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of cryptocurrency or USDC as target payment rail creates crypto-exposure alarm at the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive AML/CFT policy tailored to virtual assets; written confirmation of no anonymous wallets; wallet and transaction code mapping; expect-transaction-volume projection; evidence of conversion through an SBP-licensed crypto exchange and clear fiat settlement path; robust counterparty KYC/transaction monitoring procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status of beneficial owner or involvement of an offshore corporate services provider.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent integrity report; PEP status declaration with reasoned waiver from the bank; certified ultimate ownership chart; physical branch or opening profile showing economic shoot; explanation and evidence of legitimate source of funds; full service-provider license and background documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are executed via SWIFT MT103 transfer to the Panama S.A.'s U.S. Dollar operating account at the SBP-licensed bank. Payment must identify the beneficial shareholder and the purpose code as 'Foreign Direct Investment' or 'Capital Contribution' — Panama does not require central-bank approval for such inflows. The sending bank should reference the entity's corporate registration number and the receiving bank's correspondent instructions (typically routed through a U.S. Fedwire/CHIPS participant due to Panama's dollarized system). For USDC-based capital injection, conversion should occur at the regulated digital-asset service provider and only the resulting fiat wire should be presented to the bank, accompanied by the source-of-funds and conversion report, to avoid triggering blanket crypto-to-bank blocked transfers.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade and operational settlements, Panama S.A. disburses primarily through SWIFT MT103 for invoice payments, license fees, and intercompany costs, with MT202/COV used for bank-to-bank obligations. Commercial documentary Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700 series) are available through Tier-1 Panamanian banks for goods-backed transactions. Domestic clearing is handled by the Cámara de Compensación and dollar transfers between local banks execute same-day; international settlement routes via CHIPS/Fedwire through each bank's U.S. correspondent network. No exchange-control authorization or prior license is required for outbound payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards available via international counterparties when settlement currency is not USD (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on restricted Latin American currencies under ISDA master confirmation terms
Cross-currency swaps for multi-currency intercompany funding and receivables offset
FX vanilla options covering payable and receivable exposures arising from non-USD fee arrangements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial income tax model: foreign-source income generated by the AI/LLM API platform is outside the Panamanian tax base. No general statutory tax holiday is available, but qualifying 'Sede de Empresa Multinacional' operations and certain special economic zones may access reduced rates (5%–15%) subject to local investment and employment commitments. A Panama S.A. used solely for foreign cloud API sales may effectively pay near 0% corporate income tax provided it has no Panamanian-source revenue and maintains no deemed permanent establishment in Panama.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Declaración Jurada de Renta (Form 130); e-filing via 'Sistema T@' on the Panama DGI/MEF portal (www.mef.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. Monthly advance payment declarations (Form 1110) are additionally required for taxpayers whose estimated current-year ISR exceeds B/. 10,000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than three months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A. the final fixed deadline is 31 March of the following tax period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source income from productive activities and services rendered or performed in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only API subscription/token revenue where the underlying server, data processing, or contract performance is physically located in Panama; foreign cloud inference income is excluded as territorial scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable or foreign-source income, including income exempt by treaty or by special regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter all token fees collected from non-Panamanian customers through Stripe/USDC when no Panama establishment or PE is involved; attach a supporting memorandum showing server locations, customer jurisdictions, and the absence of Panama management.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total allowable costs, deductions, and expense allocations attributable to Panamanian-source gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate hosting, compute, legal, payroll, and operational costs under a causal or gross-revenue ratio method; only deductions connected with Panama-source revenue are deductible against Panamanian tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (Box 101 minus Box 203 after adjustments and loss carryforward).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If Box 102 foreign receipts exceed Box 101, enter zero in Box 305; a nil return must still be filed on time to preserve compliance standing and preserve the five-year loss carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISR computed at the flat 25% rate on Box 305 before tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 25% applies only if Box 305 is positive and arises from Panama-source activities; compute in Balboas at the USD parity rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable after applying withholding tax credits, monthly advance payments, and dividend tax payments already made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit Panama-sourced tax withholdings and Form 1110 advance payments; non-resident shareholders may not credit the 10% dividend tax against ISR.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the statutory deadline triggers a monthly compounding surcharge of 1.5% on the overdue tax (capped at 100% of the assessed tax), a fine of B/. 50 (USD 50) for each month of delay up to B/. 1,000, and a 12.5% accuracy-related penalty where an amended return follows a DGI audit notice. Willful failure is prosecutable as tax fraud and carries imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on the gross distribution, withheld by the S.A. at the time of dividend payment. This 10% applies equally to distributions out of Panama-source and foreign-source profits unless a lower tax treaty rate is successfully invoked.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a lower DTA rate (commonly 5% or 0% under completed Panama treaties), the non-resident shareholder must: (i) prove beneficial ownership; (ii) provide a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the relevant foreign tax authority; (iii) submit Form 140 Beneficial Owner Declaration together with a sworn ownership chain; and (iv) obtain formal DGI approval before the distribution date. The S.A. then withholds the treaty-reduced rate and reports the dividend in Form 130 with a withholding annex within ten business days.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory final WHT on Panama-source royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 15%; treaty-protected cross-border payments may be reduced to between 5% and 10%. Interest on debt issued to unrelated foreign banks is generally exempt when the lender has no Panamanian establishment. AI/API platform software licensing fees are usually characterized as service income rather than royalties, and no WHT is levied if the underlying API service is consumed entirely outside Panama.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File must be prepared and filed when annual related-party transactions (including intercompany hosting, token fees, or royalties) exceed B/. 1,000,000, or when any related-party transaction involves a low-tax jurisdiction and exceeds B/. 250,000. Master File compliance is mandatory where the MNE group's consolidated revenue exceeds B/. 30,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama does not maintain the full Cayman-style ESR, but the DGI applies substance-over-form and business-purpose anti-avoidance rules. An S.A. claiming Panama tax residency or treaty benefits must demonstrate genuine local operations: physical office or server infrastructure, local decision-making, daily records, and board minutes maintained in Panama. A pure nominee shell that enjoys foreign cloud AI revenues but has no Panamanian substance will risk recharacterization, recapture of the foreign income, and cancellation of tax residency certificates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating Panama-source revenue from Stripe or USDC settlements, failing to file the annual Form 130, or deliberately characterizing domestic AI inference sales as foreign services in bad faith.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fiscal Code Articles 785-786: reassessment plus a surcharge up to 50% of the omitted tax; criminal fraud proceedings may impose 2 to 5 years imprisonment and a monetary fine of 2 to 10 times the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false returns become jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and interest; courts may issue travel bans, attach personal assets, disqualify the individual from board service, and order the judicial dissolution of the S.A.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a nominee S.A. without local records, physical presence, or real decision-making while claiming Panama tax residence or DTA treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may disregard the entity for tax purposes, reattribute the foreign API income to the ultimate beneficial owner, revoke the tax residence certificate, and impose fines between B/. 5,000 and B/. 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face administrative sanctions and criminal liability under the beneficial ownership law, with imprisonment from 6 months to 3 years for falsely certifying economic substance; civil restitution can be ordered against individual directors for the avoided tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare, update, or submit Local/Master File documentation after intercompany cloud hosting fees or token-licensing payments exceed the B/. 1,000,000 threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may adjust the royalty or service fee by the full difference from arm's length, impose a 15% accuracy-related penalty, and disallow the deducted intercompany expense.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: CFOs and senior officers who knowingly sign deficient documentation can be held civilly liable for the adjustment shortfall, suspended from appearing before the DGI, and fined personally when gross negligence or intentional distortion is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the natural-person shareholder behind a bearer-share chain, failing to report beneficial owners to the Panama Beneficial Ownership Registry, or processing crypto wallet payments for sanctioned jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama Law 23/2015 and Executive Decree 163/2021, fines range from B/. 100,000 to B/. 1,000,000; the company's commercial registration and residency certificate may be suspended or cancelled.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, resident agents, and compliance officers incur criminal liability under anti-money laundering rules, with imprisonment up to 12 years, travel bans, and prohibition from managing any Panamanian corporation if the AI/LLM platform is used for illicit funds flow.
